# Rollout design spec

Text-bearing source document whose document identity is primary, as opposed
to a generic imported binary. The document's own cover-page date and a
verbatim source metadata flag are preserved even though the flag literally
spells `true` as text rather than a boolean.

Design specification for the rollout sequencing and rollback plan.
